description: Java source code for an Android activity handling user authentication, including login UI, background authentication task, and account management.

classes.name: AuthenticatorActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a login screen, manages user authentication, and interacts with the account manager.

classes.name: UserLoginTask
classes.description: An AsyncTask inner class that performs user authentication in the background.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and retrieves intent data.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns a progress dialog for authentication.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles login button click, initiates authentication process.

methods.name: finishConfirmCredentials
methods.description: Completes credential confirmation and updates account password.

methods.name: finishLogin
methods.description: Completes login process, adds account if new, and sets sync settings.

methods.name: onAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Handles the result of authentication attempt, updates UI and account accordingly.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message to display on the login screen based on current state.
